parts.description: Classic stamped-steel step-through moped chassis with integrated lower fuel tunnel and bulletproof single-speed engine cradle.
Tubular backbone frame with removable rear subframe built to house a dual-pulley variated swingarm drivetrain.
Stiff twin-spar steel moped frame built around a compact 2-speed automatic transmission cradle and top-bar tank mount.
Conventional spring-damped telescopic front fork with standard 22.2mm handlebar clamp and drum brake stay.
Split-case aluminum single-speed moped engine block with wet centrifugal clutch housing and 4-stud cylinder deck.
Case-inducted reed-valve crankcase built for variated belt drive, snappy midrange torque, and high thermal stability.
Compact horizontally split crankcase integrating a 2-speed automatic ATF-bathed gearbox and sprag clutch.
38mm bore factory 49cc air-cooled 2-stroke barrel with mild commuter port timing and forgiving thermal dissipation.
45mm big-bore aluminum cylinder with bridged exhaust port and high-flow boost transfers. Demands richer jetting and B7HS/B8HS plug.
Factory cast aluminum cylinder head sized for 38mm bore with conservative 8.5:1 compression ratio.
CNC-machined 45mm squish-band high-compression head with deep radial fins for big-bore builds.
Cast aluminum 49cc piston with dual iron rings and crown arrow that MUST point toward the exhaust port.
Lightweight 45mm high-RPM piston with thin chrome ring and exhaust port arrow marking.
Hot heat-range short-reach spark plug suited for stock 49cc cruising and cold SF fog commutes.
All-around medium-cold heat-range spark plug ideal for piped 50cc and mild 70cc street setups.
Cold heat-range spark plug built to pull heat out of high-compression 70cc kits up Oakland Hills grades.
Restricted factory 12mm intake spigot for round-bowl and flat-slide carburetors.
Unrestricted 15mm-19mm intake manifold with carbon reed petals eliminating blowback at low RPM.
Reliable German-style 12mm slide carb with adjustable needle clip and tickler/choke lever.
Simple, snappy 15mm flat-slide moped carb — easy to tune via main jet swaps with classic snap-back choke.
Full-circuit 19mm carburetor with independent pilot jet, air screw, 5-clip needle, and big-bore top-end flow.
Quiet factory intake silencer box that shields against SF coastal mist while adding moderate intake restriction.
Free-breathing pleated mesh pod filter with throaty intake bark; leans out AFR and dislikes Karl the Fog downpours.
Classic welded steel fuel tank with 0.6L reserve pickup. Older swap-meet tanks carry rust scale risk unless filtered.
Whisper-quiet steel baffled exhaust offering flat low-end tractor pull up to 5,800 RPM before choking top end.
Tight under-case S-loop multi-cone expansion chamber with alloy silencer — East Bay slingshot hit up to 22+ mph midrange without starving off the line.
Straight-cone 2-stroke race chamber: hollow below 5,500 RPM, explosive powerband hit from 6,500-9,800 RPM. Tune clutch or rollers to match!
Vintage 6V breaker-point ignition plate. Authentic flicker at idle; prone to rubbing-block drift and >95C condenser heat-soak.
High-output brushless 12V CDI ignition eliminating points drift and condenser heat-soak with steady spark past 10,500 RPM.
Mild-spring wet centrifugal clutch engaging smoothly around 2,900 RPM for calm neighborhood launches.
Stiff blue-spring 3-shoe centrifugal clutch holding launch until 5,200 RPM so expansion-piped bikes launch right into the powerband.
Continuous centrifugal belt variator shifting smoothly across 2.6:1 to 0.95:1 ratios modulated by roller weights.
Two-speed sprag-clutch automatic transmission delivering snappy 1st-gear starts and crisp upshift into 2nd.
Lightweight 36-spoke steel rim with 2.25-16 street tread. Compliant over potholes; classic vintage moped stance.
Cast aluminum 5-star snowflake mag wheel — zero loose spokes on West Oakland potholes with crisper turn-in.
Basic spring-over-tube rear shocks; soft ride that bottoms out over heavy Oakland chuckholes.
Progressive-rate coilover shocks engineered for loaded cargo racks and rapid pothole chatter.
Balanced swept chrome moped handlebars with neutral posture and predictable steering.
Aggressive tucked-down handlebars unlocking maximum aero tuck speed gain on flat Bay Crossing runs.
Wide braced BMX bars offering huge leverage over Muni rails and potholes at the cost of reduced aero tuck.
Lightweight sprung single saddle keeping pedaling geometry crisp on steep SF climbs.
Long moped cafe bench seat letting riders slide way back into a deep aero tuck.
Classic chrome/enamel round headlight whose warm amber glow dims and flickers in lockstep with 6V magneto RPM.
Retro square housing packed with bright 12V LED optics that slice straight through SF Karl the Fog.
Light spring-clamp rear luggage rack good for 1 courier parcel slot and bungeeing spare oil.
The unmistakable Bay Area Moped Mondays courier staple: perforated crate with corner zip-tie lugs expanding cargo to 4 slots plus +4 Tool Roll slots.
West Oakland Garage floor workstand anchoring the active moped at wrenching height.
Oil-stained steel workbench for carb teardowns, jet swaps, and porcelain spark-plug color checks.
Shop-built inertia drum roller letting you test jetting, air leaks, and CHT safely indoors.
5-liter calibrated mixing jerrycan for blending 32:1, 40:1, 50:1, or hazardous 0:1 straight gas.

Lean low-speed idle pilot jet.
Standard idle pilot jet.
Rich street pilot jet for crisp off-idle snap.
High-flow 19mm carb pilot jet for big-bore builds.
Die-cut cellulose gasket sealing crankcase deck to 50cc cylinder.
Wide-transfer crankcase base gasket sized for 45mm 70cc cylinder ports.
38mm bore crush head gasket.
45mm high-compression copper head gasket.
Heat-insulating gasket sealing intake manifold flange against vacuum air leaks.
Soft annealed copper ring that crushes evenly under M6 flange nuts.
Gravity-feed brass petcock with internal reserve standpipe.
Flexible premix-resistant fuel line connecting petcock to carburetor.
Inline micro-mesh fuel filter blocking fuel tank rust flakes from clogging your carburetor jets.
Keyed steel magneto rotor with cooling fan fins.
Rubberized resistor spark plug cap protecting ignition spark in SF fog.
Light 5.0g variator weights holding engine revs higher into expansion pipe powerbands and steep hills.
Factory 7.0g variator roller weight set for smooth street shifting.
Heavy 8.5g rollers forcing early upshifts for quiet flatland cruising.
Cogged V-belt driving the Bramble PA50 dual-pulley transmission.
Short-geared 11T drive sprocket multiplying hill-climb torque for steep SF Twin Peaks grades.
Balanced factory 13T drive sprocket.
Tall 16T front sprocket for flat-out Embarcadero/Bay Crossing runs; sluggish on steep hills.
Standard 45T rear steel sprocket matching 415 moped chain.
Small 38T rear sprocket lowering cruising RPM at 40+ mph.
Standard 415 moped roller chain; keep slack between 12-18 mm to avoid thrown chains over potholes.
Wrap-around front mudguard keeping Karl the Fog road spray off the cylinder head.
Factory drum brake shoes — adequate around town, prone to thermal fade down Grizzly Peak switchbacks.
Water-grooved high-friction drum shoes shrugging off long Oakland Hills descents.
Bolt-on 180mm hydraulic front rotor caliper kit — zero fade and one-finger stopping power.
Lubed inner-wire front brake Bowden cable.
Full-length rear brake Bowden cable.
Low-friction throttle cable linking twist grip to carb slide.
Clean-burning synthetic 2-stroke premix oil minimizing exhaust carbon buildup at 50:1.
Everyday 40:1 two-stroke premix oil balancing ring protection and mild exhaust smoke.
Sweet-smelling 32:1 castor-synthetic oil for 70cc break-in and high-CHT hill climbs; dirties baffled pipes faster.
Essential stamped-steel tubular wrench for pulling hot spark plugs on the curb.
Pre-gapped spare spark plug sealed in a cardboard sleeve for instant roadside swap.
Compact flathead screwdriver for carb float bowls, main jets, hose clamps, and points screws.
Slender pliers for clipping 415 chain master links and fishing dropped carb needles.
Precision leaf gauge (0.05-0.80 mm) for gapping 6V breaker points and spark plug electrodes.
The single most-used wrench on any European or Japanese moped: head nuts, intake bolts, exhaust flanges, and racks.
Long-beam 15mm box wrench for wheel axle nuts, chain tensioning, and engine mounts.
Replacement 415 spring-clip master link saving you from the Pedal of Shame after a thrown chain.
Folded backup variator drive belt for roadside swaps on long East Bay rallies.
Loosens rusted, heat-cycled exhaust studs so they don't snap or strip when wrenching.
Calibrated beam/click torque wrench preventing stripped cylinder head studs and under-torqued air leaks.
Essential specialized puller to pop magneto flywheels cleanly off tapered cranks for points/condenser swaps.
Small brass bristle brush for scrubbing fouled wet carbon off spark plug electrodes.
Pocket aerosol cleaner for blasting rust dust out of clogged main jets on the roadside.
Backup 0.22uF 6V condenser ready for emergency heat-soak roadside replacement.
